summary: This document outlines the company’s paternity leave policy, which aims to support employees in balancing career and family responsibilities while complying with statutory obligations. Eligible employees—biological fathers, partners, or spouses of the mother—may take up to two consecutive weeks of leave, starting from the birth or a specified period after the expected due date, and must provide notice and a self‑certificate of eligibility. The policy details the procedure for requesting leave, the rights and protections employees retain while on leave (including job security and continued benefits), and the options for statutory or enhanced company pay. It also explains how paternity leave can be combined with shared parental leave, requiring the former to be taken first and outlining notice and eligibility requirements for the latter.
